scope: Dense offline direct-correction study; equivalent query counts are not production measurements

protocol.selection: simultaneous largest recursive Schur residual_i squared / Schur diagonal_i
protocol.history: one combined A-normalized correction per block, FIFO at requested pair cap
protocol.verification_operator: original full A, with recovered eliminated coordinates
protocol.production_column_model: K[:,J] minus coarse product and regularization diagonal
protocol.iteration_dense_access: Schur columns only; no full Schur matvec
